prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a rough low-fidelity UX sketch review board for "Money Stories / UI v2". Landscape image, four complete tall mobile wireframes side by side, readable large text, generous separation. Pencil/ink lines on warm white paper, restrained pale green emphasis, pale amber notices. Clear typed lettering inside hand-drawn frames. No photorealistic devices, no polished gradients. A small road with dashed center, stone-shaped date markers and one small walking person appears across the upper part of journey screens; content cards occupy most space. Top brand Money Stories and profile circle D. Journey screens have Today and Jump to date controls, bottom Journey / Money navigation and Record expense button. Horizontal swipe changes date; vertical content scroll. All figures fictional recorded spending or planned amounts, never a bank balance. Every phone has a large numbered scenario title ABOVE it and one short interaction annotation BELOW it. All four phones fully in frame; no overlapping annotations. Header "UI v2 — [board title]" and tiny "Concept sketches • Sample data • For review".
Board title Daily journey. Four screens:
01 TODAY. Selected Sep 15 stone on road with Sep 14 / Sep 15 / Sep 16. Day heading "Today · 15 September". Activity card "5 expenses recorded" "₹3,000 today". Change card "September recorded spend" "₹18,400" "+₹3,000 today". Story card "Your month so far" "See how these expenses changed your story" button "Read story". Note "Swipe the road to change days".
02 BUSY DAY. Selected Sep 14. Heading "14 September". "12 expenses · ₹4,250". "Activity" three compact rows "Groceries ₹1,850", "Travel ₹900", "Other expenses ₹1,500", "View all 12". "Story update" card "More of this month's spending went to groceries." "See evidence". Note "Group activity; expand when needed".
03 QUIET DAY. Selected Sep 13. Heading "13 September". Spacious central card "No activity recorded" "Add an expense for this date". Small text "No new story published". Small link "Last story · 12 September". No zero-spend assertion, no success badge. Note "No invented story for an empty day".
04 JUMP TO DATE. Journey background with date picker sheet, title "Jump to a day", September 2026 monthly calendar grid, 15 selected, "Open 15 September", "Back to today". Note "Reach older dates without repeated swipes".
